title: Counting fringes with a Michelson interferometer
caption: Moving one mirror by λ/2 changes the path by λ and shifts the pattern by one fringe, so the number of fringes is N = 2d/λ. For λ = 632.8 nm, 2000 fringes correspond to d = 2000 × λ/2 = 0.633 mm.
alt: Graph of fringes counted against mirror movement from 0 to 1 millimetre: a straight line through the origin passing through 2000 fringes at 0.633 millimetres.
description: The horizontal axis is the mirror displacement in millimetres; the vertical axis is the number of fringes that have passed.
The line is N = 2d/λ with λ = 632.8 nm: one fringe per λ/2 = 316.4 nm of movement.
At 2000 fringes the mirror has moved 0.633 mm.

checks.name: 2000 fringes of 632.8 nm is a movement of 0.633 mm
